desc:
🏡 DECORATE YOUR DREAM HOME 🏡

Build the cutest home on the street! Start with your own little house and decorate it with 1,000+ pieces of furniture, decorations, and accessories.

🎨 MAKE IT YOURS 🎨
Recolour almost everything you place! Customise your furniture, wallpapers, floors, ceilings, doors, fences, and more to create your perfect style.

🔨 BUILD YOUR WAY 🔨
Knock down walls and create huge open-plan rooms. Design cosy bedrooms, giant kitchens, gaming rooms, gardens, and anything else you can imagine!

🏰 UPGRADE YOUR HOME 🏰
Grow your little house into a massive mansion. Own many homes and save them into home slots (swap them out any time!)

💸 EARN COINS AND ROBUX 💸
Explore the town, complete activities, and show off your best home for Robux donations!

👫 BETTER WITH FRIENDS 👫
Play together with friends and earn up to 4x coins!

🏆 CLIMB THE LEADERBOARDS 🏆
Most Favourited, Most Time Played, Most Robux Earned or Donated
